title: Fuuka finds the full moon Shadow

cues.text: In the command room, you stand in a ring with Ikutsuki, Junpei, Yukari, Akihiko and Mitsuru around Fuuka. Her Persona towers over her, a huge figure in a gown whose wide skirt closes around Fuuka like a glass dome, with Fuuka standing inside it.
Fuuka's Persona bursts apart into sparks and is gone, and Fuuka stands in the middle of the room again.
